packageRules.description: The tests say whether these broke anything: merged without a person when the checks are green.
The actions the checks run on.

The look. The kit workflow rebuilds kit.css on the branch and commits it when the sample page looks the same, pixel for pixel; then the checks are green and this merges by itself. A look that changed fails that workflow and waits for a person.
prBodyNotes: If the `kit` check failed, the sample page looks different with this update: compare the pictures in its `look` artifact. If the new look is right, run `pnpm build` on this branch, bump the version above the one on main, and commit. Repositories that copied `kit.css` copy it again when it changes.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of the kit merge by themselves once the checks are green; a major waits for a person.
The checks run its page gates on the example deck (tests/deck-gates.sh), with two controls that must fail. A major waits for a person.

The sample documents record what was measured with these versions. Updating them means measuring and reading again, which is not mechanical: no pull request until it is asked for on the Dependency Dashboard.
prBodyNotes: On this branch: run `verify-doc.mjs` on `docs/figure-cheatsheet` and `docs/dataviz` (both pages of each), update the versions in their `checks.json` and text, and render the figures again with `--write`.
